correctness.rationale: Independently reconstructed the cubic 18-vertex Pappus graph from the exact frozen RESULT.md LCF word and verified 27 edges, bipartiteness, distance-shell unordered-pair counts (27,54,54,18), diameter 4, and precisely six disjoint distance-four triples. A fresh independent 2^18-mask clique census reproduced face vectors r=1 (18,27), r=2 (18,81,108,18), r=3 (18,135,540,1215,1458,729); independent GF(2) boundary reduction reproduced ranks r=2 (17,64,18), r=3 (17,118,422,793,665), hence Betti counts 26 H2 and 64 H5. The analytic homotopy argument is sound: for r=2 every clique is pure-color or has exactly one vertex on one side (absence of C4), giving K2=U union V with intersection G. Mixed-cone simplices collapse onto the pure-color flag complexes, each D3*D3*D3 ≃ wedge^8 S2 and simply connected. Maps G→U,V from a graph are nullhomotopic; cofibration homotopy pushout is U∨V∨ΣG ≃ wedge^(8+8+10)S2. At r=3 the distance-four six 3-cliques complement makes K3 exactly D3^(*6) ≃ wedge^64 S5. At r=1 the triangle-free graph has cycle rank 10; r=4 is a simplex. Since successive positive homology degrees 1,2,5 do not overlap, homology inclusion maps between them vanish, yielding all stated field-independent barcodes. All quantifiers concern a fixed finite graph with inclusive real scales, not an extrapolated graph family.
residual_risks: Exhaustive finite computations establish combinatorial premises for this one graph, not a theorem about all graphs; the general homotopy conclusion additionally uses standard CW-cofibration pushout and join properties.
No formal proof assistant or external expert attestation; no claims on altered metrics or equivariant homotopy.
